events.title: Cubuild Demo Is OUT!
events.summary: Today, the Cubuild Demo is finally out on Steam after a long development journey!The Cubuild Demo includes 10 levels (excluding the howtoplay level), with the final level being a boss level.Although this Demo is based on the first chapter of the full game, we made some adjustments specifically for the Demo to make it feel complete on its own, while still leaving something to look forward to in the full version.If you enjoy Cubuild, I hope you'll consider adding it to your wishlist!
